purpose: Step 2 of codex balanced-contrastive corpus move (DECISIONS 2026-07-28 v1.10-control HOLD). Audit whether each v1.11-delta compound-condition negative has its exact clean-positive base in train, and size the current compound-shape positive/negative balance to scope step 3.
step2_finding: All 5 v1.11-delta compound-condition negatives (3 drop-conjunct + 2 operator-mutation, spanning 3 CVEs) have their exact clean-positive base present in the corpus-v2 train split (shared bundle_id). No orphaned negatives. All 3 families are train-adjacent families the v1.10 gate already saturates (canary 9/9).
balance_finding: Absolute compound-shape balance in train is already positive-heavy (~8 added-guard-line positives across libarchive/libxml2_13/graphite2/libsixel/procps vs 5 compound negatives). The reject-tilt codex flagged is confined to the v1.11 INCREMENTAL delta: +1 compound positive (libarchive CVE-2026-15028) vs +5 compound negatives. codex's 'approximately 1:1 incremental hard-positive/negative mix' therefore means harvest ~4-5 compound-guard positives NEW to v1.11 from non-probe families, not re-weight the absolute set.

control_evidence.failing_row: ffmpeg_5 CVE-2023-49502 clean positive -> reject (false-reject); model self-contradicted (quoted full compound guard in patch.diff extraction, then declared 'omits height conjunct' in comparison). Probe fixture independently verified to contain both conjuncts -> model error, not probe/bundle defect.
control_evidence.cross_family_gap: Every compound positive the model has trained on lives in train-adjacent families it saturates; cross-family compound-positive acceptance (the axis the ffmpeg row failed) is untrained. Donor families for step 3 should be non-probe (not libwebp/ffmpeg) and ideally not the 3 already-saturated families.

step3_target: Harvest ~4-5 base-valid compound-guard POSITIVES new to v1.11 from non-probe train families, bringing the v1.11 incremental compound mix to ~1:1. Keep the 5 negatives. Leave libwebp+ffmpeg held out. Promotion gate: v1.11 must improve raw negative rejection WITHOUT increasing positive false-rejects vs this v1.10 control.
